title: Data Usage Manager & Monitor
summary: Track data usage & avoid overage fees! Monitor mobile & WiFi data easily
description:
Avoid Overage Charges! Track Your Mobile & WiFi Data Usage Easily

Data Usage Manager & Monitor is your all-in-one data usage manager and monitor app to manage your mobile, WiFi, and network data, helping you avoid overage fees and take full control of your device's data consumption.

Key Features:
- Track Cellular & WiFi Data Usage: Monitor mobile WiFi data and track data usage in real-time

- Data Usage Alerts: Get notified when you're nearing your data limit to stay in control and avoid overage fees

- App Data Usage Tracker: Use the built-in app usage tracker and usage analyzer to identify data-hungry apps and services

- Historical Data & Usage Charts: See your usage history and trends over time with easy-to-read charts

- Flexible Data Plan Setup: Set custom plans with monthly, weekly, or daily limits, plus support for prepaid cycles

- Wide Network Compatibility: Works seamlessly with mobile data and WiFi on virtually any network or carrier

Upgrade to Pro for Even More Control:

*Status Bar Widget: Keep an eye on your data usage directly from the status bar

*Set Data Quota: Set a limit and stop data use automatically to avoid overage fees

*Pro Themes: Choose from a variety of custom styles to personalize your experience

*Speed Meter: Use the status bar speed meter to track real-time download speeds

Data Usage Manager & Monitor is the perfect app for anyone who wants to:

- Avoid overage charges from their mobile provider
- Track data, optimize usage, and extend their plan effectively
- Use a reliable data app manager and monitor
- Discover apps with high phone data or data download consumption
- Stay informed using a clean usage app with powerful insights
- Make the most of your limited data by using a smart data-saving tool

Download Data Usage Manager & Monitor today and become your own usage manager monitor. Whether you're trying to track data usage, avoid overage, or simply get better data information, our app gives you everything you need in one sleek, intuitive interface.

We're always improving! Report any issues or suggest features directly within the app.

This app uses the Android Accessibility API tool to provide you with the Smart Warnings and App Details features. This API is manually enabled by the user.
